Package io.telekom.orchest.enginecore.bpmn.service

Class TimerEventRegistrar

java.lang.Object
io.telekom.orchest.enginecore.bpmn.service.TimerEventRegistrar
public class TimerEventRegistrar extends Object
Handles all timer-related event registration: intermediate timer events, start timer events, gateway-linked timer events, progressive retry timers, and cycled timer re-registration.
